dct_description_sm: Road network with main, secondary and tertiary roads. This network-based connectivity approach mainly uses population centres, such as, Union capital, State/Region capital, Main town, other town and village location, as the bases to road network. Main Road links ST/R Capital to Main Towns and to Neighbouring countries. Secondary Road links a Major Road to another Main Road. Tertiary Road links main town to other-town and other-town to other-town. Original dataset title: Myanmar Road Network 2022
